Good morning everyone, and thank you for joining us. Over the last quarter our team shipped three major features. First, we rebuilt the onboarding flow from scratch. New users now reach their first success in under two minutes. Second, we launched offline mode, which was the most requested feature in our survey. Third, we cut the average page load time in half. These changes had a real impact on our numbers. Weekly active users grew by 18%, and churn dropped to its lowest level in two years. Looking ahead, we will focus on collaboration features. Teams have told us they want to share projects and leave comments in real time. We plan to deliver a first version by the end of March. Thank you, and I am happy to take your questions.
